title: A Paradox — the water makes the clean unclean and the unclean clean
summary: The four statements of the paradox (priest, ash-gatherer and water-sprinkler become unclean; the sprinkled unclean man becomes clean) are repeated, with a larger conclusion added: the water makes the clean unclean and makes the unclean clean.

text.text: The clean priest who does the sacrifice becomes unclean.
The clean man who gathers the ashes becomes unclean.
The clean man who sprinkles the water becomes unclean.
The unclean man who is sprinkled becomes clean.
The water makes the clean unclean and makes the unclean clean.
